in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Gault in Hebrew is derived from the Hebrew word 'galt' which means 'calf'. This name was possibly given to someone who owned or tended to cattle.

in_greek.name: Γαυλτός
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Gault in Greek is derived from the Greek word 'gaulos' which means 'calf-herd'. This name was given to someone who took care of calves or was a shepherd of cattle.
